name: Rock, Art and the X-ray style

podcast.body: The first album released by Joe Strummer and The Mescaleros in 1999. It marked Joe's return to recording new solo material after a nearly decade-long dispute with his previous record label. "In 1999, Joe Strummer and the Mescaleros released an album called Rock, Art and the X-ray style."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
